2026-10-23FIN, MINTRoyal Canadian Mint ActOrder Amending Part 2 of the Schedule to the Royal Canadian Mint Act, 2026Order Amending Part 2 of the Schedule to the Royal Canadian Mint Act, 2026 in order to produce the one-dollar coin in bronze-plated steel and the inner core of the two-dollar coin in aluminum bronze while the outer core would continue to be made of multi-ply nickel-plated steel.Registration: SOR/2026-0224 Publication Date: 2026-11-04
subject: Order Amending Part 2 of the Schedule to the Royal Canadian Mint Act, 2026
precis: Order Amending Part 2 of the Schedule to the Royal Canadian Mint Act, 2026 in order to produce the one-dollar coin in bronze-plated steel and the inner core of the two-dollar coin in aluminum bronze while the outer core would continue to be made of multi-ply nickel-plated steel.
